title: New Peer-Reviewed Studies on Rare Earth Element Microbial Interactions Published in ACS Omega and ESPR
search_description: Dr. Asef M. Redwan and international collaborators from Idaho National Laboratory report significant proteomic and metabolic findings on anaerobic bacterial responses to europium and samarium in ACS Omega and Environmental Science and Pollution Research.
excerpt: Dr. Asef M. Redwan and international collaborators from Idaho National Laboratory report significant proteomic and metabolic findings on anaerobic bacterial responses to europium and samarium in ACS Omega and Environmental Science and Pollution Research.
body_html:
Two peer-reviewed research papers exploring the interaction of microorganisms with technology-critical rare earth elements (REEs) have been published in leading international environmental journals.

The first paper, appearing in ACS Omega, resolves quantitative proteomic shifts in Clostridium sporogenes exposed to europium and samarium, revealing distinct ATP synthase and electron transfer flavoprotein expression patterns. The companion paper in Environmental Science and Pollution Research documents concentration-dependent physiological impacts on Sporacetigenium mesophilum, providing molecular groundwork for biomining and critical material recovery.
